title: Cache Redirects
description: Use cache redirects to prevent duplicate queries and optimize Apollo Client cache usage.

data.text: Cache redirects tell Apollo Client to use existing cached data for a query instead of sending a network request. This is useful when multiple queries request the same object but with different shapes or when a component needs data that was already fetched by another component.

data.title: Cache redirect example
data.content: Redirect user query to cached Profile data.

items: Avoid duplicate network requests for the same entity.
Share data between components with different query needs.
Reduce server load by maximizing cache hits.
Improve perceived performance with instant data.
data.title: Use Cases

data.text: Combine cache redirects with `cache-and-network` fetch policy. The redirect provides instant cached data while the network request updates it in the background.
data.title: Best Practice
Cache Redirects Key Points
points: Redirects reuse cached data for queries.
Use with cache-and-network for best UX.
Ideal for shared entities across components.
data.takeaway: Cache redirects are a powerful optimization for maximizing Apollo Client cache efficiency.
